blocks.text: Río Celeste and Tenorio Volcano National Park

After breakfast, set out for the Río Celeste in Tenorio Volcano National Park.

Follow trails through the cloud forest, where you may spot local wildlife and plants. The trail then leads to Los Teñideros and the Río Celeste Waterfall.

The water here is bright turquoise. According to an old legend, God washed his brushes in this river after painting the sky.

There are hot springs along the Río Celeste.

After the tour, return to Hotel el Silencio.

Arenal Hanging Bridges, Sky Tram, Sky Trek and canyoning

Start the morning with a walk across the Arenal Hanging Bridges. The route takes you above the rainforest, with views of Arenal Volcano and Lake Arenal.

The afternoon is devoted to outdoor activities.

First, take the 15-minute Sky Tram cable car ride through the jungle to the Miguel Ángel viewpoint, where you can see Arenal Volcano and the lake.

Next comes the Sky Trek canopy tour. Several zip lines cover about 2.8 km in total, reaching a maximum height of 201 m.

Then go canyoning in Lost Canyon. The route includes rock climbing and navigating six waterfalls using climbing equipment. The first waterfall is about 5 m high and the tallest is around 50 m.

You can also go rafting on the Balsa River. The route covers more than 16 km through a canyon, gorges and stretches with waterfalls, with Class II–III rapids. It also suits people with little rafting experience.

Return to Hotel el Silencio Relais & Chateaux.
